senses.gloss:
श्रोण śroṇá, a. lame (RV.): ā́, f. N. of the 🞄20th (21st) lunar asterism (= śravaṇā;
 V., P.).

श्रोणि śróṇi, f. buttock, hip (—˚ a. ī): -kapāla, n. thigh bone;
 -bimba, n. round hips.
श्रोणी śroṇī, f. later form of śróṇi: -bhāra, 🞄m. weight of the hips.
श्रोतृ śró-tṛ (w. ac.) or -tṛ (w. g.), a. hearing, 🞄m. hearer, auditor (V., C.): also used as future.

श्रोत्रिय śrótr-iya, a. [concerned with hearing: 🞄śrotra] versed in sacred lore, conversant 🞄with the Vedas;
 m. Brāhman learned in the 🞄Veda, learned theologian (mantri-, minister 🞄learned in the scriptures): -sāt-kṛ, present 🞄to Brāhmans learned in the Veda.
श्रोमत śró-mata, n. fair fame, celebrity 🞄(RV.): in. pl. gloriously.

स्रोतोरन्ध्र sroto-randhra, n. aperture of an 🞄elephantʼs trunk;
 -vah, f., -vahā, f. river.
स्रोत्या srotyā́, f. [√ sru] flowing water, 🞄stream, surge (V.).
